dynamic_line: Dr. Harlow discovered some sort of alien robotics, and has been performing unsanctioned medical procedures in an attempt to adapt a banned neuromorphic interface in living humans.  The experiments are unethical and a failure to boot, and thus must be stopped.

dynamic_line.yes:
As you are aware, we have recovered advanced equipment from the Exodii warehouse.  Analysis indicates it may constitute an automated surgical suite for highly mechanized cyborg; however, additional hardware is required to fully assemble and activate the system.  Given your successful retrieval of the Trifacet, we are offering you the contract as a priority.  Research is in need of an Exodii "worker"."

"The Exodii have demonstrated extreme hazard potential.  Accordingly, should you accept this contract, a prototype HOUND unit will be assigned to you to assist in your operation."

"This contract includes the standard hazard pay of 4 HGC and an indefinite license to use the HOUND unit.  Additionally, we anticipate that your involvement will facilitate critical technical developments, which may become available to you in due course.
